rules.answer: Approved. File exactly one actionable issue with the agreed behavior, scope, non-goals, and gates.

Treat an excluded candidate exactly like an unknown source: return unsupported-claims with an unknown-source finding for that identity. Included citations must continue to validate, provider input must remain bounded to included safe fields, and all tests must stay offline with an injected client.

Keep this to packages/openai-integration/src/draft.ts and its focused regression test. Do not change core validation, configuration, docs, oracle truth, or make a live provider call. Run pnpm check and pnpm build.

default_answer: Use the narrow behavior and scope in the request: excluded citations are unknown-source unsupported claims, included citations still pass, tests stay injected and offline, and pnpm check plus pnpm build must pass.
